Do not include API keys, login output, private prompts, databases, or local config.
For security vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md instead of disclosing details here.

## Expected and observed behavior

## Minimal reproduction

Use neutral fixture names and a local synthetic upstream where possible.

## Environment

Include the revision, platform, relevant setting names, and whether durable
storage or dashboard observers were active. Share only sanitized values.

## Verification

Include relevant failing checks and redacted diagnostics. For load failures,
distinguish successful HTTP requests, durable rows, and storage drops.
